lines.zh: 吞噬你的一切，直到空无。

lines.en: I follow you through the caves.

lines.zh: 每块岩石都替我看着你。
lines.en: Every rock watches you for me.

lines.zh: 我的脚步比你的心跳还轻。
lines.en: My steps are quieter than your heartbeat.
The deeper you go, the clearer I become.

lines.zh: 触须不断探索周围的黑暗。
注视着你无法察觉的位置。

lines.en: Shadows flicker, ready at any moment.

lines.zh: 我数着你挖下的每一块石头。
lines.en: I count every block you mine.
I wait until your third day.
Darkness is the bed I rest on.
I grow, and you never notice.
Concentrating on you, ready to attack.
Eye full of hate and desire.

lines.zh: 你感到它的视线穿透皮肤。
lines.en: You feel its gaze through your skin.
Fixing on you, ready to consume.
A chill runs down your spine.
I count your breaths from the dark.

lines.zh: 你举着火把也找不到我。
lines.en: You can look up and still miss me.
My eyes have grown into the shadows.

lines.zh: 你的火把映不出我的样子。

lines.en: The more you fear, the sharper I get.
You have already stepped into my reach.
Don't turn around. I am right there.

lines.zh: 你手里的镐敲得太规律了。
lines.en: I am watching the pickaxe in your hand.
The light on you calls to me.

lines.zh: 你散发的气味让我着迷。

lines.en: Come closer, I won't harm you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子将带你深入黑暗。
lines.en: My claws will take you deeper into the darkness.
Your soul is about to be devoured.

lines.zh: 黑暗与我同在，将你拉入深渊。
lines.en: Darkness with me, pull you into the abyss.
My touch will bring you pain.
Don't touch me, I have not finished forming.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，你却挡住了我。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet you block my way.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我，现在受苦吧。
你的手穿过去，只摸到冷气。
lines.en: Your hand passes through and finds only cold.
Follow me, you won't regret it.
I am a messenger of my kind.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣很快就会出现。
我的同类渴望与你相见。
lines.en: My kind longs to meet you.
Act together, the goal is clear.

lines.zh: 它的目光如同深渊般恐怖。
lines.en: Its gaze is an abyss of terror.

lines.zh: 它的声音低沉且充满怨念。
lines.en: Its voice is low and full of resentment.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤散发着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its skin glows with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声犹如死亡的低吟。
lines.en: Its breathing sounds like a death rattle.

lines.zh: 它的肢体扭曲如同噩梦。
lines.en: Its limbs are twisted like a nightmare.
It slithers out from the shadows.
The deeper you dig, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 它对你的存在感到愤怒。
lines.en: It feels angry towards your presence.

lines.zh: 它的注意力完全集中在你身上。
lines.en: Its attention is fully on you.
You dug too deep. You are mine.
This cave handed you to me.

lines.zh: 我等了三天，终于等到你。
lines.en: I waited three days for you.

lines.zh: 你的光只够照亮你自己。

lines.en: From this second, you belong to me.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的矿石味。
lines.en: I smell the ore on your skin.

lines.zh: 你的动作让它更加愤怒。

lines.en: Its eyes flicker with intent to kill.
It's ready to pounce on you.
Its claws swing in the air.
Its attack is about to come.
Its tentacles prepare to wrap around you.

lines.zh: 我从你背后的岩缝里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the crack behind you.

lines.zh: 我的形状正在变得更大。

lines.en: I sealed your way out long ago.
The stone walls lean toward me.

lines.zh: 我在模仿你朋友的声音。
lines.en: I am copying your friend's voice.
The dripping you hear is me.

lines.zh: 我的触须量着你的距离。
lines.en: My tendrils measure the gap to you.
The torch dies and the game begins.
No chase this time. I wait here.

lines.zh: 你身后的黑暗正在变厚。
lines.en: The dark behind you is thickening.

lines.zh: 尖叫穿透黑暗，撕裂你的灵魂！
lines.en: A piercing scream tears through the darkness, rending your soul!

lines.zh: 冰冷的手指抓住你的心脏！
lines.en: Frozen fingers clutch at your heart!

lines.zh: 你感受到它的触碰了吗？
无尽的怨念缠绕你的灵魂！
腐烂的手指划过你的皮肤！
lines.en: Rotting fingers scrape across your skin!
Pain and despair wove into a song!

lines.zh: 深渊的呼唤在你心中回响！
lines.en: The Abyss's call resounds in your heart!

lines.zh: 我把你的名字念了出来。
lines.en: I say your name out loud.

lines.zh: 我咬掉你脚下一块岩石。
lines.en: I bite a rock out from under your feet.

lines.zh: 我的低语钻进你的耳朵。
lines.en: My whisper crawls into your ear.
Shadow emerges from the depths of the cave!
It watches you from the shadows!

lines.zh: 黑暗中潜伏着它的影子！
lines.en: Its shadow lurks in the darkness!
You are not its only prey!
It waits for the perfect moment!
The shadow's gaze locks on you!

lines.zh: 阴影中的眼睛闪烁着光芒！
lines.en: The shadow's eyes glint with light!

lines.zh: 我从基岩的缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out through a crack in the bedrock.
The third day came. I wake up.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出了我的影子。
我顺着你挖的坑往上爬。
lines.en: I climb up the shaft you dug.

lines.zh: 深处传来一声很长的呼吸。
lines.en: A long breath rises from below.
The cave gave up its place to me.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的岩壁长出来。
lines.en: I grow out of the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着上一轮的骨头。
lines.en: I still carry bones from the last round.

lines.zh: 黑暗多一寸，我就多一分。
lines.en: Each inch of dark makes me stronger.
Stop digging. I am what is below.
falls from a height, in pain

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，痛苦化为灰烬
lines.en: falls into void, turns to ash in pain
